wish: someone should make a tool that turns text into a timeline diagram
spec:
Turns lines like "1969: moon landing" or "1939–1945: war" into a timeline drawn to scale, top to bottom.
Type or paste one event per line (years, full dates, BC, ranges); the diagram redraws as you type and saves to SVG or PNG.
It does not fetch dates from anywhere, guess missing years, or lay events out horizontally.

type.text:
1903: first powered flight
1939–1945: Second World War
1969-07-20: moon landing
